turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
No, an item cannot be added to an order after it has been placed. The existing order needs to be cancelled and refunded first, then you can place a new order with the additional item.

If you would like me to check your order, please send your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number entered when you placed it.

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
If the order has already shipped, it can no longer be changed to add or replace an item.

If you want to cancel it, you should refuse the parcel at delivery. It will be returned to the warehouse and the refund process will begin. You can then place a new order with the item you need.

turns.q: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
turns.replyTail: No. Once placed, separate orders cannot be combined into one shipment. Each order is processed and shipped independently, so you will receive them as separate shipments.

turns.replyTail: Please send your order number and the email address used for the purchase. I’ll check the available option for changing the payment method on that order.
